subject: EpiHub kickoff: from forecast archive to weekly pipeline
body:
Team,

Kicking off the EpiHub operationalization. Today our open-source archive holds prospective quantile forecasts for three public-health targets - US jurisdiction-level weekly influenza, COVID-19, and RSV hospitalizations - organized by target hub and season, with files named YYYY-MM-DD-[model_name].csv in the hub-standard format. What partners actually need is a pipeline that produces those files every week without a human in the loop.

Milestones for the Mar 30 - Jun 15 window: automated weekly generation for flu-hub by Apr 24, all three hubs (flu, covid19, RSV) plus backtesting against the 2025-2026 season by May 22, reliability review and partner handoff decision by Jun 12.

Success metric: 8 consecutive weekly submissions with zero manual fixes and weighted interval score at or better than our archived 2025-2026 baseline.

Jelena owns staffing and budget.

Viktor
